notes: Method: rows are the union of (a) every row the critic's section 2 names ('The triage skipped rows that are sole witnesses'), including its 'still skipped from the round-8 list' bullet, and (b) every row named on a WITNESS SKIPPED BY TRIAGE line in section-dnd.md, whose feature number was read from the numbered feature heading immediately above each line. Every row below was confirmed SKIPPED_TRIAGE in state-dnd.json. Ranges expanded in full: 1073-1076, 1093-1096, 1110-1112, 1115-1117, 1118-1122, 1125-1127, 772-777, 783-785, 811-816, 825-831, 753-758, 725-730, 773-776, 800-802, 1085-1089, 1057-1068, 1137-1144, 851-853, 856-859. Rows the critic or section named in a range that are NOT SKIPPED_TRIAGE and are therefore excluded: 756=VERIFIED_VERBATIM, 814=VERIFIED_VERBATIM, 828=VERIFIED_VERBATIM. Note that 1057-1068 and 1137-1144 were named by the section only as bulk ranges under feature 58 ('the style-guide bylines and the DMs Guild page (1057 to 1068, 1133 to 1136); Perkins and Bilsland's principles at the primary (1137 to 1144)'), not individually argued; the critic's own section-2 subset of that block is 1061, 1131, 1132, 1134, 1136 under feature 1. The critic recommends 'a verify-only pass over about 120 named rows (the 84 above plus the round-8 list)'; this list is 152 rows, larger than 120 because it also takes the per-feature WITNESS SKIPPED lines the section carries for features 27, 29, 31, 33, 34, 36, 38, 41, 46, 51 and 57. The 192 SKIPPED_TRIAGE rows sit in four angles (72 scholarship-history, 30 usability-school, 84 place-editorial-staff, 6 place-srd-measure); this list covers all 84 of place-editorial-staff. routeQuestioned is listed but not judged, per the brief: 944-962 are the nineteen 2014 DMG rows read from the archive.org full-book OCR (verdicts recount to the critic's '15 kept, 4 PARTIAL'), and 932-939 plus 972-984 are the twenty-one 2024 DMG rows on roll20.net behind the purchase banner (recount to '14 verbatim, 1 substance, 6 PARTIAL'). None of the 40 is SKIPPED_TRIAGE, so none appears in rows.
